description: GULA Platform API Contract — frozen catalog of every published endpoint. Auth, role-gates, rate limits, pagination, and deprecation metadata are declared per-operation.

GET.summary: Readiness check — DB reachable, migrations OK

POST.summary: One-time platform initialisation (creates root admin + first lab)

GET.summary: List patients with pagination, search, and filters
Get clinical history for a patient
Lookup patient by exact phone number

POST.summary: Convert guest patient to full record

GET.summary: List lab results with pagination and filters

POST.summary: Create multiple results in one request
Create an amended version of a result

GET.summary: List all amendments for a result
Get status-change timeline for a result

POST.summary: Generate a printable report for a result

GET.summary: Main dashboard summary for current user
List labs with pagination and filters
List labs shared with current user
Get lab location data for mapping
List users assigned to a lab

POST.summary: Add a holiday to lab schedule

GET.summary: List samples with pagination and filters

POST.summary: Mark sample as received in lab

GET.summary: Get full audit history for a sample

POST.summary: Scan an identity document (Iraqi national ID/card)

PUT.summary: Mark a single notification as read

GET.summary: List EHR records shared with current user

POST.summary: Share an EHR record with another lab/user

GET.summary: Get audit trail with hash-chain verification
Get Levey-Jennings chart data for a test

POST.summary: Send notification for a critical alert

GET.summary: Get execution log for a batch

POST.summary: Assign a lab to a tier

GET.summary: Get status of a national ID
Get coverage details for an insurance
Get AI interpretation for a result

POST.summary: Generate a digital patient card (QR + HMAC)
Scan a patient card QR token

GET.summary: Get patient card by HMAC token
Get longitudinal history for patient card

POST.summary: Report AI telemetry from model execution

GET.summary: Get AI model telemetry per model
Get Levey-Jennings data for a test
Get LIMS QC record by ID

GET.summary: Lookup citizens by query (name, phone, NID)
List pending identity claims requiring adjudication
